what: THE deposit record. Every Zenodo archive of this repository, its DOI and its date, in one place. tools/check-wiring.js gates CITATION.cff against it.
why: CITATION.cff named version v2026.09.1 and carried the DOI of v2026.09 for a day and a half — 10.5281/zenodo.22257596 instead of 10.5281/zenodo.22285003. Nothing caught it, because the version string and the DOI were two facts nobody had written down together. They are written down together here.
conceptNote: Resolves to the latest archived version. This is the DOI the site pages and the papers cite, and it is the only one that should appear in prose that outlives a release.

titleLag.shouldBe: cert-machine: independent exact certification of machine-generated mathematics
titleLag.liveTitleIs: cert-machine: verification layers for AI-scale mathematical search (certified audits, proof-grounded evals, verified reward channels)
titleLag.note: The repository adopted ONE description on 2026-09-03 (CLAUDE.md D1) and it is correct in CLAUDE.md, README.md, .zenodo.json and CITATION.cff. The three published Zenodo records still carry the retired title, because .zenodo.json only governs a NEW deposit — it does not rewrite a published one. Metadata edits on a published record are allowed and mint no new DOI. Only the depositor's account can make them, so this cannot be closed from here.
titleLag.howToClose: With a personal access token (zenodo.org → Applications → Personal access tokens, scopes deposit:write + deposit:actions): ZENODO_TOKEN=... node tools/zenodo-metadata.js --apply — it edits, updates and publishes each record, re-reads the public record to verify, and closes this entry itself. Without a token: zenodo.org → Upload → the record → Edit → Title → paste shouldBe → Publish, for 22285003 and 22257596; then `node tools/zenodo-metadata.js` (no token) verifies and closes this entry. The concept record inherits the title of its latest version.
titleLag.decided: 2026-09-05 — both repository snapshots (v2026.09.1 and the superseded v2026.09) take the ONE title, so the concept DOI inherits it; the current version also takes .zenodo.json's description, keywords and related identifiers (the live record still says isSupplementTo where .zenodo.json says isNewVersionOf); the lambda(4) deposit keeps its own title, it is a different work.
